per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall return parts search results within 15 seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The search for recycled parts shall take no longer than 15 seconds. The search results shall be returned in under 15 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall return repair facility search results within 8 seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The search for the preferred repair facility shall take no longer than 8 seconds. The preferred repair facility is returned within 8 seconds'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall be responsive and lightweight for mobile use, allowing field staff to work on flaky cellular connections.
The system shall have a 98% uptime to ensure high reliability and minimize manual workarounds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall achieve a 98% uptime. The product shall not fail more than 2% of the available online time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall follow corporate architecture and UI standards to avoid governance issues and ensure alignment with existing systems.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall adhere to the corporate Architecture guidelines'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall comply with accessibility standards to meet customer expectations and market perceptions.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall comply with corporate User Interface Guidelines'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall use a hybrid approach for data handling, providing the freshest data where possible and a cached snapshot in areas with bad reception.
The system shall guide users away from non-compliant choices and make exceptions explicit to ensure regulatory compliance.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall comply with insurance regulations regarding claims processing.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall have help available in about 9 out of 10 screens or workflows to ensure usability.

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall achieve a 95% ease-of-use satisfaction rate as measured by post-rollout surveys.

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall ensure that field users have access only to the details relevant to the claim they are handling, to avoid overwhelming and risky exposure to sensitive data.

per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall comply with insurance regulations regarding claims processing.'
